```{r}
#analyse full matrix
coldata<-read.csv("sample_name_ALl.csv")
coldata
#read in counts . Host only data
countData <- read.csv("Aiptasia_all_counts_HOST_final2024.csv",header = T, row.names = 1)
countData

dds=DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=round(countData),
                           colData= coldata,
                           design =  ~strain+treatment)

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep,]
#one step DESeq
dds<-DESeq(dds)
# transform the data for plotting 
rlogMF=rlogTransformation(dds, blind=TRUE)
rld=assay(rlogMF)
table(complete.cases(rld))
write.csv(rld, "~/Desktop/RLog_normalized_aiptasia_counts.csv", quote=F)
```
```{r}
#Baseline DGE of sym and apo
# Filter for control samples only
control_coldata <- coldata[coldata$Treatment_1 == "Control", ]

# Ensure the countData only contains columns for the control samples
control_countData <- countData[, control_coldata$X]

# Create DESeqDataSet object with control samples only
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(control_countData),
                              colData = control_coldata,
                              design = ~ state+strain)

# Filter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep,]

# Run DESeq analysis
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Output results
results(dds)
#nit vs control pairwise comparisons of apo data
control_coldata$state<-factor(control_coldata$state, levels=c("sym","apo"))
res_state <- results(dds, contrast=c("state","sym","apo"))
res_state
#how many FDR < 10%?
table(res_state$padj<0.05)
#FALSE  TRUE 
# 4972   116  
summary(res_state, alpha=0.05)
#out of 22689 with nonzero total read count
#adjusted p-value < 0.05
#LFC > 0 (up)       : 50, 0.22%
#LFC < 0 (down)     : 66, 0.29%
#outliers [1]       : 15, 0.066%
#low counts [2]     : 17586, 78%
write.table(res_state, file="DGE_sym_State.txt", quote=F, sep="\t")
```

```{r}
# Categorize the genes as upregulated or downregulated
# Function to categorize and summarize data
summarize_data <- function(data, label) {
  data$regulation <- ifelse(data$log2FoldChange > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated")
  summary_data <- as.data.frame(table(data$regulation))
  colnames(summary_data) <- c("Regulation", "Count")
  summary_data$Dataset <- label
  return(summary_data)
}

# Summarize each data frame
ApoNitrate <- summarize_data(res_apoNit_fltd, "ApoNitrate")
ApoHeat <- summarize_data(res_apoHeat_fltd, "ApoHeat")
ApoHnit <- summarize_data(res_apoHnit_fltd, "ApoHnit")
SymNitrate <- summarize_data(res_symNit_fltd, "SymNitrate")
SymHeat <- summarize_data(res_symHeat_fltd, "SymHeat")
SymHNit <- summarize_data(res_symHnit_fltd, "SymHNit")

# Combine all summary data frames
combined_data <- bind_rows(ApoNitrate,ApoHeat,ApoHnit,SymNitrate,SymHeat,SymHNit)
combined_data$Dataset<-as.factor(combined_data$Dataset)
# Set the order of the Dataset factor
combined_data$Dataset <- factor(combined_data$Dataset, levels = c("ApoNitrate","ApoHeat","ApoHnit", "SymNitrate","SymHeat", "SymHNit"))
str(combined_data)
# C
col<-c("Upregulated"="Red","Downregulated"="Blue")
# Create the combined stacked bar plot
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = Dataset, y = Count, fill = Regulation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Treatment",
       y = "Count") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col)+coord_flip()+geom_text(aes(label = Count), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "grey")

ggsave("~/Desktop/Aip2024_DGE/DGE_stack_barplot.pdf", width = 4.3, height = 3)
```

```{r Make bubble plot from stingdb enrichment}
# Example data frame
data<-read.delim("~/Desktop/All_BP_State_Enriched_filtered.txt", header=TRUE)
str(data)
data$Treatment=as.factor(data$Treatment)
data$State=as.factor(data$State)
colvec<- c("Heat"="coral1","Heat+Nitrate" = "#D65278")
# Add a column for -log10(FDR)
data$neg_log_fdr <- -log10(data$false.discovery.rate)

# Create the bubble plot
ggplot(data, aes(x = observed.gene.count, y = term.description, size = neg_log_fdr, fill=Treatment)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colvec)+
  scale_size_area(max_size = 10) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Gene Count",
    y = "Description",
    size = "FDR(-log)",
    title = "Enriched pathways in heat"
  ) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12))+facet_wrap(~State)
ggsave("~/Desktop/ALL_BP_enriched.pdf", width = 15, height = 12)
```
```{r}
# Load necessary library
library(dplyr)

# Read the CSV file (assuming the file is named 'data.csv')
data <- read.delim("All_BP_State_Enriched_filtered.txt")
# Check the structure of the data to confirm the column names
str(data)
# Filter rows where "term description" is "Apoptotic process"
apoptotic_data <- data %>% filter(term.description == "Apoptotic process")
# Retrieve the "matching.proteins.in.your.network..labels." column from the filtered data
gene_labels <- apoptotic_data$matching.proteins.in.your.network..labels.
# Split the genes by commas
split_genes <- strsplit(as.character(gene_labels), split = ",")
# Unlist the split genes and create a new dataframe
apop_genes_df <- unique(unlist(split_genes))
# Unlist the split genes and remove duplicates
apop_genes_df <- unique(unlist(split_genes))
# Create a new dataframe
apop_genes_df <- data.frame(Gene = apop_genes_df)
#make a heatmap of apoptotic and immune genes, bin by state
```
